SECURITY • PAGE 2

THE VCASS ALARM SOLUTION

Picture this.

Two men approach, eyes on the van. They’re sure it’s another easy target.

But then, just from the other side of the vehicle, they hear the sound of a large, aggressive, growling dog filling the air.

They don’t see the dog, but I doubt they want to.

They decide not to take a chance on this vehicle and run away. They’re gone.

That’s VCASS in action. Not just a horn, but a sound you choose — a sound that fits your situation.

And when it’s all over, it will be good to know it’s your vehicle again.

The video preview needs an internet connection to load.

We hope, as a company, that the VCASS system never has to use this feature with anyone. But if it does, you’ve just experienced the VCASS Alarm Solution.
